''See also: [[Tartarus steel Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|[[Tartarus]] [[steel]] is an exceptionally rare, expensive, and mirror-bright metal characterized by its near-indestructible properties. When forged and treated correctly, it is almost impossible to break, though it can be countered by other blades made of the same material. While this metal easily pierces standard metals, it is capable of resisting much stronger forces. It is used to craft various high-level items, including massive war hammers, swords like the [[Dragon's Fang|Dragon's Fangs]], and small silver-colored keys used by [[Tartarus Travelers]] for summoning. Because of its extreme durability, it is also utilized in the construction of padlocks and heavy armor.}}

== The Crimson Vault ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|[[Tartarus]] [[steel]] is a mirror-bright material characterized by being all but unbreakable. This substance was utilized to forge [[Indirial]]'s war-hammer and serves as a type of blade material. The metal is used to craft summoning keys for [[Tartarus Travelers]], as well as a soldier's shining sword.}}
